$comment: Controller identifiers extracted (static string analysis of MotorData libMDCore.so arm64-v8a) as UNVERIFIED STATIC IDENTIFIERS. These are text names of module groups per manufacturer — NOT CAN addresses, NOT a list of a specific vehicle's modules, NOT proof of ELM327 support. Never treat an entry as a readable ECU without a verified profile (see shared/obd/modules.json). category is a heuristic label for grouping only.
